MIRA VALE TO TESS ROWAN. November 03, 1849
Dear colleague,
The east depot reported
receiving the canal register
sent by Tess Rowan in response
to the request of October 31,
1849.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.

TESS ROWAN TO MIRA VALE. November 03, 1849
Dear colleague,
In response to that request of
October 31, 1849, I, Tess
Rowan, sent the canal register
to the east depot.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
